# Warlock AI Anthropic

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-anthropic`

> Anthropic SDK adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [Package orientation](@warlock.js/ai-anthropic/skills/index.md): Provider adapter for Anthropic Messages API for Claude in Warlock AI applications. Exports `AnthropicSDK` with model and provider configuration for the shared AI contracts. Use when connecting this provider, configuring extended thinking, prompt caching, token counting and usage costs, or diagnosing provider requests and usage. Read `setup-anthropic` for construction and examples using ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Not this package: agent loops, tools and workflows → @warlock.js/ai; HTTP and MCP tools → @warlock.js/ai-tools.
- [setup-anthropic](@warlock.js/ai-anthropic/setup-anthropic/SKILL.md): Wire @warlock.js/ai-anthropic — new AnthropicSDK({apiKey, baseURL?, provider?}) for Claude, .model({name, vision?, structuredOutput?, reasoning?, thinkingMode?, promptCaching?, maxTokens?, maxOutputTokens?}). System-prompt hoisting, max_tokens required (default: model max output when streaming, 16384 non-streaming; maxOutputTokens for gateway ids), extended thinking via options.reasoning → adaptive thinking + output_config.effort (current/unknown models) or budget_tokens (Haiku 4.5, 4.6 and older; override with thinkingMode), prompt caching via promptCaching + options.cacheControl (per-call ttl), provider blocks (thinking/compaction) replayed verbatim via ModelResponse.blocks / Message.blocks, providerOptions.anthropic (betas, body fields such as context_management / fallbacks, thinkingDisplay), model.countTokens(), distinct finish reasons (pause_turn, refusal, context_exceeded), built-in Claude list prices (ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PRICING, anthropicPricingFor, withAnthropicCacheWriteRates), cost-truth usage (inputIncludesCache: false, cachedTokens/cacheWriteTokens/cacheWrite1hTokens, usage.cost on complete()), ProviderOverloadedError for 529, no first-party embeddings. Triggers: `AnthropicSDK`, `anthropic.model`, `anthropic.count`, `maxTokens`, `maxOutputTokens`, `max_tokens`, `reasoning`, `thinking`, `budget_tokens`, `thinkingMode`, `adaptive`, `cacheControl`, `providerOptions`, `blocks`, `countTokens`, `pause_turn`, `refusal`, `context_management`, `contextManagement`, `serverCompaction`, `clear_tool_uses`, `clear_thinking`, `thinkingBlockBinding`, `block_binding`, `preservedThinking`, `ai.providerTool`, `web_search_20250305`, `bash_20250124`, `text_editor_20250728`, `streamChunks`, `thinking_delta`, `compaction`, `promptCaching`, `cachedTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `cacheWrite1hTokens`, `inputIncludesCache`, `ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PRICING`, `ProviderOverloadedError`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `claude-opus-4-7`; "wire claude into warlock agent", "configure anthropic provider", "use claude sonnet", "anthropic gateway baseURL", "claude extended thinking", "anthropic prompt caching cost"; typical import `import { AnthropicSDK } from "@warlock.js/ai-anthropic"`. Skip: embeddings — the `setup-openai` topic of the `warlock-js-ai-openai` skill; sibling adapters `@warlock.js/ai-openai`, `@warlock.js/ai-bedrock`, `@warlock.js/ai-google`, `@warlock.js/ai-ollama`; raw `@anthropic-ai/sdk`; Vercel `@ai-sdk/anthropic`.
